Two dogs are a few feet directly ahead, with open paved space around them. The camera wearer then turns toward a nearby woman in red, who is within conversational distance and appears oriented toward the wearer; other people stand farther behind/right and are not blocking the path. No telescope is visible or within reach. The woman’s proximity and apparent direction-giving make cooperating with her and performing the next scene the most appropriate action.
